According to the source [Just the Two of Us (Grover Washington Jr. song)], the edited version of "Just the Two of Us" reached number two on the Billboard Hot 100, staying there for 3 weeks, behind "Bette Davis Eyes" by Kim Carnes.  
According to [Bette Davis Eyes], "Bette Davis Eyes" is a song written and composed by Donna Weiss and Jackie DeShannon, and Carnes's 1981 version spent nine weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100.  

Final answer: nine
